# Support

For installation, supported providers, and commands, start with the [README](../README.md). This is pre-release software with no response-time guarantee.

Join the [Aiden by Opheleon Slack community](https://join.slack.com/t/aidenbyopheleon/shared_invite/zt-4apsg5d7p-FDO9ae0imxj~KgauP8lpsw) for setup help, questions, and feedback. You can also open this community from the app's Slack button.

For bugs, use the repository's issue template and include the app version, macOS version/architecture, expected and observed behavior, and a minimal reproduction using synthetic repositories. Include only sanitized error categories. Remove names, private paths, source, prompts, reports, and credentials from screenshots and logs.

Provider authentication, account eligibility, usage limits, and billing remain controlled by the provider. Do not post tokens or ask maintainers to use your account.

Security issues use the private route in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
